{{Quote|I'm afraid they don't want the ship&mdash;they want the bacta!|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Bacta Raid" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a group of [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] deserters aboard the ''[[Wayfarer (spice transport)|Wayferer]]'' led by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[M'rch]] '''raided''' the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|''Pelta''-class frigate]] ''[[Medica]]''. They posed as a damaged vessel and sent out a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress call]]. When the ''Medica'' approached, they docked and stormed aboard to steal [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]], although they were stopped by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone trooper sergeant]] [[Bolt (clone trooper)|Bolt]].<ref name="Bacta Raid" />
